premise: Arcade jet-boat race down a red sandstone canyon river: beat three rival boats to the lagoon while threading gates, collecting suns, hitting boost pads and ramps, and surviving the waterfall leap.
actions: Boost (Space/Shift, A button) spends boost meter

loop.goal: Finish the point-to-point canyon course in the best position and time with the highest score
loop.success: Cross the finish gate; result shows position, time, score and medal
loop.failure_or_pressure: Three AI rivals; rocks and walls cost speed and combo; missed gates add a time penalty; DNF if the clock exceeds the limit
loop.restart: Restart from results or pause menu fully resets race state, entities, effects, audio and input

mechanics.mutation: fixed-step hull velocity/heading integration with lateral grip, river current
mechanics.feedback: bank, bow lift, spray, engine pitch, speed card

mechanics.precondition: gate is the next ordered gate
mechanics.rejection: passing outside marks the gate missed once: +3 s penalty, combo reset

mechanics.mutation: extra thrust and higher top speed while held; meter drains

mechanics.input: drive up a ramp or off the waterfall lip
mechanics.mutation: vertical velocity, airborne state, air-time score on landing

mechanics.input: contact with rock, bank or rival
mechanics.mutation: velocity reflected/damped, combo reset on rock/bank

mechanics.input: R or automatic when stuck > 2.5 s
mechanics.mutation: placed on centerline at last progress, speed zero, +2 s penalty

invariants: Gates count only in order; each gate resolves exactly once (passed or missed)
Each sun pickup awards once per race
Score never decreases; combo resets on rock/bank hit or missed gate
Boat stays inside the river corridor at boosted speed (swept collision)
Progress is monotonic for finish detection; finish requires all gates resolved
Restart restores the exact initial state (deterministic sim: same inputs -> same result)
An autopilot using only the public input struct can finish the course

levels.description: ~2.4 km point-to-point river: start basin, S-bends, rapids with rocks, narrow gorge, ramp, waterfall drop, lagoon finish

assumptions: A single still cannot show rules; all mechanics are authored
Timer in reference is treated as elapsed race time
